name: Can I add a bathroom or wet bar anywhere in my basement design?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a bathroom or wet bar anywhere in my basement design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing for a basement bathroom or wet bar can be installed virtually anywhere, provided the sub-slab slopes properly toward the main sewer line. Because basement fixtures sit lower than the rest of the house, installing them requires saw-cutting the concrete slab to lay waste pipes and tie into the sewer stack. A major design decision factor is whether your home already has plumbing rough-in pipes stubbed into the concrete. If not, placing wet fixtures closer to the main sewer exit minimizes concrete cutting, labor, and project expense.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but it requires cutting into the concrete slab to lay drainpipes. Placing wet areas closer to existing sewer lines reduces labor and concrete excavation costs.
